    AI Mode replied:

    You can calculate Sharia-compliant property distribution online using the Faraid Calculator on HalalWallet or the Islamic Aid Inheritance Calculator. 
    How Islamic Inheritance (Faraid) Works
    • Step 1: Pay Debts: All outstanding debts, funeral expenses, and unpaid financial obligations must be cleared from the estate first. 
    • Step 2: Allocate Bequests (Wasiyyah): Up to a maximum of one-third (1/3) of the remaining net estate can be allocated via a will to non-heirs or charities. 
    • Step 3: Distribute Fixed Shares: The rest of the estate is divided among eligible blood relatives and spouses according to fixed Quranic shares (Fard).
